bar.empty: The bar is empty. Drag spells, items or anything else from the lists below onto it.
bar.noCharacter: No character. Ask your gamemaster to assign you one.

keybindings.toggleHudHint: Switches between the HUD and Foundry's own interface, like the exit button of the HUD.

mode.name: Player HUD
mode.hint: Replaces Foundry's interface with the HUD on this device. Automatic shows it to players and not to gamemasters.

minimapImage.name: Scene picture on the minimap
minimapImage.hint: The minimap is the whole scene with a pin where the character stands. Of the scene's picture it shows only what you have explored (fog of war) or nothing. A gamemaster can also pick the full map.
minimapImage.fullmap: Full map, also what was never seen

toastSeconds.name: Chat message time
toastSeconds.hint: Seconds a new chat message stays in the corner before it fades.

chat.name: Chat button
chat.hint: A button in the HUD that shows Foundry's chat for writing. Without it new messages still bubble up, and dice are rolled with the dice button.

stats.deathSave: Dying: click to roll a death saving throw

journal.noGm: Your notes are created by the gamemaster's client, and no gamemaster is online right now.

combat.unseen: You do not see {name} on the map.
